estimated_steps: Make 3-4 deep slits on both sides of the pomfret.
Rub with salt, turmeric and lemon and keep aside for 10-15 minutes.
Dry roast the Kashmiri chillies, garlic, ginger, and cumin until aromatic, then blend them with jaggery, turmeric and salt into a smooth, thick paste.
Apply the masala generously all over the fish, inside the slits and the cavity. Marinate for at least 1 hour.
Mix rice flour and fine rava. Lightly coat the fish on both sides. The coating should be thin, not thick.
Heat coconut oil on a tawa over medium heat. Shallow fry the fish until golden and crisp on both sides. Avoid high heat so the masala caramelizes without burning.
tips: Avoid high heat to prevent burning the masala.
Ensure the coating is thin but not too thick.
